# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release on the `main` branch is supported. Older versions do not receive security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| latest (`main`) | Yes |
| older versions | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately using GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira.com/security/advisories/new

We aim to respond within 48 hours. Please do not open a public issue for security-related problems.
